events.title: Demo 1.0.33: Mute in Background
events.summary: Thanks for your feedback! This Demo update brings the following improvements: Added “Mute in background” under Settings → Audio. It is enabled by default and can be turned off at any time. When enabled, music, game sounds, and UI sounds are muted while the game is unfocused. Returning to the game restores your current volume settings. Background idle progress is unaffected. Shortened some volume labels in several languages to make the audio settings clearer.

events.title: Demo 1.0.31 Update Notes
events.summary: Added a Shop button to the bottom of the backpack for easier access to buying and selling. Split the Shop and Forge into separate windows that can stay open together. Buy and Sell are now in the Shop; Forge and Salvage are in the Forge window. Organizing your backpack or storage now automatically merges matching material stacks where stacking rules allow. Improved equipment messages to explain why an item cannot be equipped. Fixed display and crafting calculation issues involving large material
